title: AC3-required [E10] citation is absent from the PR body
evidence: AC3: "PR body: the touch-point list (enum/selector/growth), the per-type profile table (throughput/volume/cap + the math), the era gating, the re-bless cause chain, citations `[ODN-5]` `[ODN-7]` `[E10]` `[E31]` `[E9.1]`." The committed PR body contains [ODN-5], [ODN-7], [E31], [E9.1], [ODN-11] but zero E10: `grep -n "E10\|\[E1" _bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md` → exit 1, no matches. The closest E10 substance is "golden harness ×33 demos + replay gate" in the Verification line — un-cited.
detail: Replay byte-identity [E10] is hard requirement #6 of the spec, and AC3 explicitly enumerates [E10] in the mandatory citation list; the PR body omits it while citing the other four.
recommended_fix: Add the [E10] citation to the replay/golden line of the PR body (e.g. 'replay byte-identical [E10]'), matching the spec's tag.

title: PR body misdescribes terminal_types.dem setup as "fixture + one small_biz + one campus"
evidence: PR body: "New `demos/terminal_types.dem` (era 3, growth on, fixture + one small_biz + one campus)". Actual demo: "seed 42 / era 3 / run 32000ms / fixture off / growth on / spawn_node router_mid 20 15 / spawn_node residential 8 15 / spawn_node content_host 32 15 / spawn_node residential 14 22 / spawn_node residential 26 22 / spawn_node small_biz 12 10 / spawn_node campus 30 10" — the demo is `fixture off` with explicit spawns (3 residential + 1 content_host + 1 small_biz + 1 campus), per its own header comment: "`fixture off` + explicit spawn_node directives lay out the spectrum (run setup — re-created identically on every replay, like the fixture)".
detail: The card's named golden is real and correct (all three classes visible — runtime-verified), but the PR body's setup description is factually wrong, misleading reviewers about the golden's construction.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body to "fixture off + explicit spawn_node (residential x3, content_host, small_biz, campus)" to match the committed .dem.
